title: A Search for High-Threshold Qutrit Magic State Distillation Routines
abstract: Magic state distillation is a key subroutine in fault-tolerant quantum computation. This work investigates magic state distillation for qutrits — three-level quantum systems — and searches systematically for distillation routines with high distillation thresholds. By analysing the qutrit stabiliser formalism and constructing candidate distillation circuits from self-dual additive codes over GF(9), we identify routines that surpass previously known thresholds, advancing the resource cost analysis for qutrit-based universal fault-tolerant quantum computers.

title: A Novel Heuristic for Estimating Two-Colorability for Conflict-Free Coloring in Simple Graphs
venue: Advances in Intelligent Systems and Computing, Springer
abstract: Conflict-free coloring requires each vertex's neighbourhood to contain at least one uniquely colored vertex. Determining two-colorability for conflict-free coloring is NP-hard in general. This paper presents a novel heuristic for estimating whether a simple graph admits a conflict-free two-coloring, based on structural graph properties and a greedy exploration strategy, achieving high accuracy on benchmark graphs.

title: On Quantum Computing and Quantum Error Correction Using Self-Dual Additive Codes over GF(9)
venue: B.Tech Thesis, Faculty of Engineering, Dayalbagh Educational Institute
abstract: This thesis investigates quantum error correction for qutrits (three-level quantum systems) using self-dual additive codes over the finite field GF(9). It develops the algebraic framework for encoding quantum information in qutrit stabiliser codes, analyses the distance properties and error-correction capabilities of these codes, and explores connections to classical coding theory. The work culminates in the construction of efficient qutrit error-correcting codes and a study of their fault-tolerant properties, laying the groundwork for subsequent research in qutrit magic state distillation.

title: Aspects of Qutrit Magic State Distillation
abstract: A poster presentation at QIP 2022 surveying key aspects of magic state distillation for qutrits, including threshold analysis, resource overhead, and connections to self-dual additive codes over GF(9). The work bridges classical coding theory and fault-tolerant quantum computation for qutrit systems.

title: Heuristic Method for Estimating Two-Colorability in Conflict-Free Graph Coloring
abstract: A patented heuristic method for efficiently estimating whether a simple graph admits a conflict-free two-coloring. The method uses structural graph properties to guide a greedy search, providing a practical polynomial-time approximation to an NP-hard decision problem with applications in frequency assignment, RFID networks, and wireless communication.

title: Productivity Improvement and Capacity Enhancement of an Automobile Industry: A Case Study
venue: International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology (IJERT), Vol. 6, Issue 11
abstract: A case study analysing productivity improvement strategies and capacity enhancement techniques in an automobile manufacturing facility. The study employs industrial engineering methodologies including time-motion studies, value stream mapping, and bottleneck analysis to identify and quantify improvement opportunities, achieving measurable gains in throughput and reduction in cycle time.
